title: Triangle of orbs follow him home and appear in his yard

tellings.quote: I had this video of a triangle of orbs going up and down making sure my security camera got it

plain: In Blacksburg, Virginia, a triangle of glowing orbs followed a CIA contractor named Bob McGwier home and showed up in his yard, he says. McGwier tells it as the one who saw it, and says he has video of the triangle "going up and down making sure my security camera got it," as if the lights wanted to be recorded.
